_about: Sources for the waterbody knowledge files. Every 'sources' list in types.json, variables.json, signals.json, roles.json, rules.json and questions.json holds ids from this file or from the watershed bibliography (knowledge/sources.json), which the waterbody atlas also reads. Where no published norm exists, a value is expert judgement (id expert_judgement) and is labelled so.

sources.citation: Ministry of Jal Shakti, Department of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation (2023). Water Bodies: First Census, 2017-18. All India and State Reports.
sources.used_for: Classes of waterbodies (ponds, tanks, lakes, reservoirs, check dams), ownership (public / private), use, filling frequency, encroachment and repair status; the fields used to check the rule patterns.

sources.citation: This atlas: comparison of the waterbody rules with the Water Body Census fields that CoRE Stack matched to the waterbodies (docs/waterbody_census_comparison.md, 22 November 2026).
sources.used_for: Six tuning changes and the direction of several likelihood ratios: waterbodies recorded as rarely full trigger inflow shortfall more often, those under repair trigger sudden loss more, those with a water user association trigger irrigation underuse less, encroached ones trigger siltation more.

sources.citation: CoRE Stack surface water body and zone-of-influence layers: seasonal water extent per hydrological year (kharif, rabi, zaid), drainage position, stream order and catchment of each waterbody, and cropping in the land it irrigates. GeoServer workspaces swb and crop_intensity.
sources.used_for: Every waterbody variable: the yearly fill series, typing fields and the zone of influence.

sources.citation: Mosse D (2003) The Rule of Water: Statecraft, Ecology and Collective Action in South India. Oxford University Press, New Delhi.
sources.used_for: Tank systems depend on inlet channels, sluices and shared rules; their decline follows the weakening of collective management, encroachment and loss of supply channels.

sources.citation: Sen PK (1968) Estimates of the regression coefficient based on Kendall's tau. Journal of the American Statistical Association 63(324): 1379-1389.
sources.used_for: Theil-Sen trend of relative fill, summer water and cropping intensity: the median of pairwise slopes, robust to one unusual year.

sources.citation: Ministry of Jal Shakti (2022) Guidelines for Repair, Renovation and Restoration of Water Bodies under PMKSY-HKKP (2021-26).
sources.used_for: The interventions for storage loss (desilting, bund and waste-weir repair, supply-channel restoration, catchment treatment) and the size range of tanks the scheme covers.

sources.citation: Press Information Bureau (2025) Mission Amrit Sarovar: progress and Phase II. PRID 2114884.
sources.used_for: Pond rejuvenation through user groups who remove silt after each monsoon.
